scope: Pairwise temporal assignment gate, a prerequisite for whole-movie integration

defect.explanation: Unrestricted assignment chose an out-of-range edge for source 7, then dropped it; the worse valid candidate consumed target 71.

policy.objective: minimum total distance plus unmatched penalties, not maximum-cardinality linking
policy.unmatched_cost: nextafter(1, +infinity) after dividing admissible distances by max_distance; zero-distance matches have cost zero
policy.distance_boundary: inclusive; one ULP below the measured boundary is rejected
policy.rectangular_matrix: Transpose when sources outnumber targets; dummy augmentation uses the smaller dimension.
policy.threshold_validation: finite non-negative max_distance; finite min_successor in [0,1]
policy.prediction_validation: Shapes match source frame; foreground vectors finite and probabilities in [0,1]; finite derived object centres. Background values ignored.
policy.prediction_dtype: Existing prediction dtypes retained for centroid voting.

private_audit.plan: Repeat the original nine synthetic supplied-mask pairs on CPU, archive dense predictions, score identical predictions with both matchers.

limitations: No new trained weights or model promotion.
Prior nine-pair scores describe the old assignment rule; they are not scores of the changed decoder.
No real-data, whole-movie, lineage, gap-bridging or end-to-end accuracy claim.
